task: Minimal sensitivity analysis for the bidirectional asymmetry

input.access: SQLite read-only URI (ecdb.raw_sql default); no writes
input.meta_sql: SELECT p.accession_no AS acc, p.pub_year AS y, p.source AS src, d.label AS lab, d.tier AS tier, d.confidence AS conf, p.num_references AS nrefs_declared FROM papers p JOIN paper_domain d ON d.accession_no = p.accession_no
input.refs_sql: SELECT r.accession_no AS acc, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.label='EC' THEN pc.accession_no END) AS n_ec, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.label='NON_EC' THEN pc.accession_no END) AS n_non, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.label='EC' AND d.tier='llm' AND d.confidence<0.75 THEN pc.accession_no END) AS n_ec_lowconf, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.label='NON_EC' AND d.tier='llm' AND d.confidence<0.75 THEN pc.accession_no END) AS n_non_lowconf, COUNT(DISTINCT r.cited_doi) AS n_refs_doi, COUNT(*) AS n_rows_all, COUNT(r.cited_doi) AS n_rows_doi FROM paper_refs_out r LEFT JOIN papers pc ON pc.doi = r.cited_doi LEFT JOIN paper_domain d ON d.accession_no = pc.accession_no GROUP BY r.accession_no
input.reused_from: research/nature/paper_bootstrap_asymmetry.py (imported for CANON, STABLE8, SEED and helpers; its two extraction SELECTs are extended in the same single pass, so no extra full-DB queries)

disclaimer.zh: 本包是最小敏感性分析组，全部为按已锁定估计规范进行的只读点估计重算，不新增不确定性区间，不改变论文级分层重抽的结论表述。低置信队列对比是标签队列稳健性检查（不是校正）；共同来源留一是来源构成敏感性（TFS 反向样本量极小，其读数本身不稳定）；解析率诊断是描述性覆盖检查，不能当成校正；2025 为右删失端点，须与 2024 并读；gap 为非配对描述性比较。
disclaimer.en: Minimal sensitivity analysis: read-only point-estimate recomputations under locked definitions only; no new uncertainty intervals and no change to the paper-level resampling statements. The low-confidence queue contrast is a label-queue robustness check (not a correction); the common-source leave-one-out is a source-composition sensitivity (TFS reverse pools are tiny and individually unstable); the parse-rate diagnostic is a descriptive coverage check and must not be used as a correction; 2025 is right-censored and must be read next to 2024; the gap is a non-paired descriptive comparison.

metrics.E1: mean target edges per citing paper
metrics.E2: share of citing papers with >= 1 target edge
metrics.E3: mean share of DOI-resolved references pointing at the target; zero-DOI-reference papers contribute 0.0

spec.gap_definition: 100 * (reverse relative change - forward relative change), percentage points
spec.weighting: per base year: source composition weights over the support, renormalised over available strata

s1_gate1_replica.rule: sources non-empty in (2021, 2024, 2025) in both directions

queue.note: queue_own_record_levels are the queue papers' own E1/E2/E3 levels in their pool (descriptive mechanism read), not additive decompositions of the gap change; the queue sits far above its pool's target-edge levels, which is consistent with borderline labels but is not a labeling verdict (the queue is not manually reviewed here); 'out_of_support' counts queue papers in in-scope years that sit in a STABLE8 source outside the frozen support (Computers and Industrial Engineering 2021) and are not in the analysis pool.

unit_excluded.label: queue removed as citing units only

full_excluded.label: queue removed as citing units AND as edge targets (deleted, not relabelled)

s3_reverse_loo.rule: sources non-empty in (2019, 2021, 2024, 2025) in both directions
s3_reverse_loo.direction_note: Common-source LOO: the dropped source is removed from both the forward and reverse support pools, and base-year weights are recomputed and renormalised separately in each direction.

focus_tfs.note: TFS reverse pools are tiny (n per year above), so both the full and the dropped variant rest on a handful of extreme papers; this LOO quantifies weight leverage of a small extreme source, not estimate stability.

s3_reverse_loo.both_direction_loo: recomputed only inside cross_check.frozen_loo_126 (read-only check; not re-emitted)

spec.base_year_role: the base year fixes the composition weights; the compared levels are always 2021 vs the endpoint (identical to the frozen bidirectional matrix spec)

summary.censoring_note: 2025 is the final collection year (right censoring); every 2025 number mixes trend with truncation and must be read next to its 2024 counterpart. endpoint_gap_delta_pp = gap(2021->2025) - gap(2021->2024) per base year and metric.

pooled_observation.note: Observed pattern: the reverse pool parses at a HIGHER rate than the forward pool in every scope year, and the two pools' rates do not move together (forward falls from 2021 to 2025, reverse rises). Because a target edge is only counted when the cited reference carries a DOI matching an in-corpus paper, this is a shared exposure of E1/E2/E3 and a plausible confound direction for the measured gap. It still does NOT license a correction: the target mix of the unparsed references is unobserved, so the diagnostic cannot sign or bound the resulting bias, and no rescaling is applied anywhere in this package.

definitions.doi_row_rate: rows with non-null cited_doi / all reference rows in paper_refs_out (per direction/year/source cell)
definitions.share_papers_with_doi_ref: citing papers with >= 1 distinct DOI reference (E3 denominator > 0)
definitions.distinct_doi_over_declared: distinct DOI references / EI-declared num_references (papers with a declared count only)
definitions.edges_in_zero_doi_papers: structurally expected to be 0: an edge is counted only when the cited reference has a DOI that matches an in-corpus paper DOI, so E1/E2 also depend on reference-DOI availability

interpretation.zh: 本诊断只描述参考文献 DOI 可用率与 E3 分母覆盖（多少施引论文有可解析的参考文献分母）。它不是校正：没有插补、没有重加权、没有按解析率外推；缺 DOI 的参考文献并非随机缺失（随年份、期刊、语料来源与存缴习惯变化），任何把观测值除以解析率或按解析率放大的做法都预设了缺失机制，本包不做这种假设，也不给出偏差方向或大小的界限。E3 是三估计量中唯一以 DOI 解析为分母的读数；E1/E2 的边也要求被引侧 DOI 能匹配库内论文，因此解析可用率是全部三估计量的共同暴露面，但本诊断不能把这种暴露换算成校正。
interpretation.en: This diagnostic only describes reference-DOI availability and E3 denominator coverage (how many citing papers have a resolvable reference denominator). It is NOT a correction: no imputation, no reweighting, no division/extrapolation by the observed parse rate. References without a DOI are not missing at random (they vary by year, source and venue deposit practice), so scaling by the observed rate would assume the missingness mechanism; this package makes no such assumption and offers no bias bound. E3 is the only estimator whose denominator is DOI-resolved references; E1/E2 edges also require the cited side's DOI to match an in-corpus paper, so parse availability is a shared exposure of all three estimators -- which this diagnostic cannot convert into a correction.
must_not: must not be used to rescale or correct E3 (or any other estimate)
must not be read as an upper or lower bound on the true cross-domain citation share
must not be read as evidence that E1/E2 are parse-rate immune

cross_check.tolerance_note: tolerances: E1/E2 gap 5e-4 pp / rel 1e-5; E3 gap 5e-3 pp / rel 1e-4, because frozen source means are r6-rounded and E3's small base amplifies the rounding

limitations: All numbers are point estimates under frozen definitions; this package adds no uncertainty intervals and no coverage claims.
Low-confidence exclusion (tier='llm' & confidence<0.75) is a robustness contrast, not a label correction; the queue is pre-registered and not manually reviewed here.

The 'full_excluded' variant deletes edges whose target is a queue paper (and can flip a paper's E2 to 0); it does not relabel targets, so the true effect of label error could differ in either direction.

Common-source leave-one-source-out reduces the same support source in both directions and renormalises each direction separately; it is a source-composition sensitivity and does not address source-selection uncertainty in general.
TFS reverse pools have 9-18 papers per scope year (18 in 2019, 11 in 2021, 10 in 2024, 9 in 2025); both the full and dropped variants rest on a handful of extreme papers.
Reference-DOI availability and denominator coverage are descriptive; no imputation, reweighting or scaling is performed, and no bias bound is claimed (missing DOIs are not missing at random).
E1/E2 edges also require the cited side's DOI to match an in-corpus paper, so the parse-rate exposure is shared by all three estimators.
2025 is right-censored; every 2025 window and endpoint number must be read next to its 2024 counterpart.
The forward and reverse pools are non-paired; every gap is a descriptive between-pool comparison.

Composition weights change between base years by design (that is what the base-period summary measures); weights under exclusion are recomputed from retained papers and reported alongside the frozen-weight variant.
Database untouched: the two SELECTs are read-only via ecdb.raw_sql; no build/enrich/cite writes were executed.
